for strict in [False,True]:
 for label,prior in [('first','reports/identity-registry.json'),('second','reports/phase-02-identity-registry.json')]:
  label=('E' if strict else 'D')+'-'+label
  cmd=['env','-u','CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID','node','scripts/check-doc-inventory-gates.mjs','--inventory',inv,'--identity-registry',p+'/reports/phase-06/working-identity-registry.json','--decisions',p+'/pilot/decisions','--decisions',p+'/ledger/decisions','--previous-registry',p+'/'+prior,'--json']
  if strict:
   cmd+=['--strict']
   for scope in scopes:cmd+=['--scope',scope]
  out=s/(stage+'-'+label+'.json')
  with out.open('w') as f:z=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
  d=json.loads(out.read_text());record={'label':label,'command':cmd,'exit':z.returncode,'stderr':z.stderr,'fatalFindings':d['fatalFindings'],'conservationOpen':d['conservationOpen']};results.append(record);(s/(stage+'-gates.json')).write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print(stage,label,z.returncode,'fatal',len(d['fatalFindings']),[(x['type'],x['count']) for x in d['conservationOpen']],flush=True)
  if not strict:assert z.returncode==0 and not d['fatalFindings'],d['fatalFindings'][:10]
